```
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let words: List of Text be
    for each line in text.to_lower().lines(), word in line.split(" ")
    where not word.is_empty()
    collect word
  let mutable counts: Map of Text to Integer be {}
  for each word in words
    let current be counts.get(word) otherwise 0
    set counts to counts.set(key: word, value: current + 1)
  end
  let mutable result: List of WordCount be []
  for each word, occurrences in counts
    set result to result.append(WordCount(word: word, occurrences: occurrences))
  end
  return for each entry in result sorted by entry.occurrences descending collect entry
end
```

```
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let words be
    for each line in text.to_lower().lines(), word in line.split(" ")
    where not word.is_empty()
    collect word
  let mutable counts: Map of Text to Integer be {}
  for each word in words
    let seen be counts.get(word) otherwise 0
    set counts to counts.set(key: word, value: seen + 1)
  end
  let result be
    for each word, number in counts
    sorted by number descending
    collect WordCount(word: word, occurrences: number)
  return result
end
```

```
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let words be
    for each line in text.to_lower().lines(), piece in line.split(" ")
    where not piece.trim().is_empty()
    collect piece.trim()
  let groups be for each word in words group by word collect word
  let counts be
    for each word, members in groups
    sorted by word
    collect WordCount(word: word, occurrences: members.length())
  return for each entry in counts sorted by entry.occurrences descending collect entry
end
```

```
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]

  let words be
    for each line in text.to_lower().lines(), word in line.split(" ")
    where not word.is_empty()
    collect word
  let mutable counts: Map of Text to Integer be {}
  for each word in words
    let current be counts.get(word) otherwise 0
    set counts to counts.set(key: word, value: current + 1)
  end
  let entries be
    for each word in counts.keys().sorted()
    collect WordCount(word: word, occurrences: counts.get(word) otherwise 0)
  return
    for each entry in entries
    sorted by entry.occurrences descending
    collect entry
end
```
